# WO-205: Refresh the safety and trust page
Status: open (revised scope; owner tracker/worktree preparation pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Kai Nakamura
Source: WO-194 / CLAUDE-036

## Goal
Make `/safety/` clear, reassuring, and easy to scan for older, tech-wary Windows users.

## Acceptance criteria
- Preserve verified safety facts and existing approved copy. Do not weaken or extend security/privacy behavior or imply absolute protection.
- Import `site-refresh.css` and wrap refreshed content in `.site-refresh`; leave Header/Footer/Base untouched.
- Use a calm explanatory hierarchy, never alarm styling or fear-based illustrations.
- Add focused built-output checks for key safety sections, links, and headings.
- Verify 320/360/768/1280 CSS px, Windows 125%/150% scaling, 200% zoom, keyboard access, D6 contrast (body >=7:1; other >=4.5:1), and >=44px tap targets.
- Audit every claim against D8; flag any claim outside its allowed list.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `web/src/pages/safety/index.astro`
- `tests/codex/test_cx_safety_refresh.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No security/privacy implementation, network policy, app, consent, forms, global chrome/styles, shared tokens, CSP, dependencies, or other routes.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- `PYTHONPATH=src FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_safety_refresh.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_safety_refresh.py`
- `pnpm check` from `web/`

## Check-in plan
Owner-prepared worktree after WO-201 is integrated on a main that includes WO-195/196.

## Notes and decisions
The in-house team freezes edits to this route while this WO is active. Report unsourced claims for owner review; do not invent replacement language.
